meta.purpose: Risk register covering every strategic decision plus black-swan candidates. Likelihood and impact are 1-5 analyst ratings (labelled), velocity is qualitative, mitigations are specific actions.
meta.ratings_rule: Likelihood/Impact ratings are analyst judgement, not official statistics; verified inputs appear in the source column.

risks.risk: Tenant does not renew at expiry (2030-2035)
risks.mitigation: Tenant's own statement supports renewals 'generally at then-current market rates' (T09); audit option rent mechanism (P01) and option notice window; obtain franchisee financials (P10); model downtime (A8) and re-leasing cost (A9).

risks.risk: Franchisee credit deterioration (unit closures, system shrink)
risks.mitigation: System lost 55 units in FY2025 (M70); AUV fell 3.8% (M72); pull Q3 FY2026 10-Q figures at decision time (M80); stress-test cap-rate band 7.00%-7.50%.

risks.risk: Cap-rate expansion between now and sale (rates stay high, spreads widen)
risks.decision_affected: Sell now vs sell later / renew-hold
risks.mitigation: Model price at 5.50%-7.50% bands; sell-now option removes mark-to-market risk; Treasury at 4.84% leaves little rate cushion (M53).

risks.risk: Tax cost of sale erodes net proceeds
risks.mitigation: 1031 exchange defers gain (T14); transaction stack is 5.06%-10.56% of price before ULA (M60-M62); owner basis unknown (P05) - CPA required before pricing any offer.

risks.risk: Below-market fixed rent if option is a fixed step-up rather than market repricing
risks.mitigation: Audit option rent mechanism (P01); renewal quote from T09 implies market repricing but is not a guarantee; model fixed-escalator scenarios (A2).

risks.risk: WALT too short for a premium buyer pool at re-sale
risks.mitigation: Extend first to create a >10-year WALT, then sell; buyers price long WALT single-tenants tighter. The brand's own franchise term is 20 years (T09), supporting extension appetite.

risks.risk: Population and job base erosion reduces QSR trade-area demand
risks.mitigation: County projected to lose 146k people by 2030 vs 2025 (M03/M04, T03); metro jobs +0.5% YoY but white-collar sectors contracting (M33/M34); monitor annually; reject long hold if declines persist.

risks.risk: Fast-food wage floor rising (Fast Food Council); local city minimum wage unconfirmed
risks.mitigation: State fast food wage $20.00 (M67) can be raised by the Fast Food Council; city rate not confirmed (M68); labour costs are tenant's line in a NNN lease but affect tenant survival and percentage rent.

risks.risk: Proposition 13 reassessment resets buyer's base value at sale
risks.mitigation: Buyer prices the tax reset into the offer; seller retains any low-base advantage only if it holds. 1% levy cap plus 2% AV cap (M57/M58) is below current CPI (M42), so long-term holding compounds a tax advantage.

risks.risk: Measure ULA surtax on a Central LA sale above $5.4M
risks.mitigation: 4.0% tier 1 ($5.4M-$10.9M) or 5.5% tier 2 (>= $10.9M) applies on top of 0.56% county+city DTT (M60-M63); thresholds indexed annually by chained CPI (M64) - re-check at sale; model net proceeds both with and without ULA mitigation structures (e.g., ground-lease split where permitted).

risks.risk: Split-roll / Prop 13 reform raises commercial property taxes
risks.mitigation: Monitor Sacramento; any repeal would hit long-held commercial assets first.

risks.risk: Wildfire (direct loss, smoke, PSPS outages) - Central Los Angeles flatland
risks.mitigation: Eaton + Palisades destroyed 16,251 structures; $5.2B-$10.1B output lost (M81-M84, T22); FHSZ classification of parcel not yet performed (M88 - flagged); insurance capacity is the binding constraint (see R-17).

risks.risk: Earthquake on the Puente Hills / Newport-Inglewood fault system
risks.mitigation: Central Los Angeles sits over blind-thrust fault systems; site classification and fault-rupture status not performed (M89 - flagged); require CGS EQ Zapp lookup plus geotechnical report; insurance deductibles are typically 10%-25% for quake - policy review (P09).

risks.risk: Flood damage
risks.mitigation: FEMA zone not yet determined for the parcel (M90 - flagged); standard NFIP placement if zone is A/V.

risks.risk: Insurance capacity / premium shock or non-renewal
risks.mitigation: FAIR Plan is available to businesses and offers up to $20M per location commercially (T20); old CDI link 404s (X-02, fixed here); commercial wildfire capacity still requires broker quote; include deductible/availability clause in any sale contract.

risks.risk: Reinvestment alternative risk - if sold at a low cap and reinvested at 4.84% Treasury, opportunity cost
risks.mitigation: Model compares sale proceeds reinvested at 4.84% vs net-lease benchmark 7.3% (T11) vs holding the NNN asset; breakeven analysis shows when holding wins.

risks.risk: Refinancing risk at above-current rates if existing debt matures near expiry
risks.mitigation: Debt terms unknown (P06); pull maturity, rate, prepayment penalty before committing to hold. Rate context: 4.84% 10-year Treasury (T12).

risks.risk: Single-asset concentration in a county losing population
risks.mitigation: County projection declines through 2040 (M03-M06, T03); diversification via 1031 into multi-tenant net-lease (T14); owner's risk tolerance drives the weight.

risks.risk: Brand-level shock at Jack in the Box (closure acceleration, franchisee failures, brand reputation)
risks.mitigation: 70% of units in CA+TX (M73); securitized debt covenants; dividend discontinued and cash to debt paydown (M77-M79); Q3 FY2026 10-Q must be reviewed before any hold decision (M80).

risks.risk: Infrastructure / utility disruption - PSPS, water, heat
risks.mitigation: Fire season creates public safety power shutoff risk even outside very-high FHSZ; drive-thru sales depend on power (FHSZ framework, T17).

risks.risk: Black swan: Metropolitan-scale wildfire (Eaton/Palisades-class event hitting the central basin)
risks.mitigation: 2025 pair destroyed 16,251 structures and cost $5.2B-$10.1B in lost output across LA County (M81-M84, T22); not modelled; no reliance placed on historical quiet decades.

risks.risk: Black swan: M7+ earthquake on a blind-thrust fault under Central LA
risks.mitigation: USGS hazard program confirmed live (T18); site-specific classification not performed (M89 - flagged); no historical-quiet reliance; insurance deductibles typically 10%-25%.

risks.risk: County population decline accelerates restaurant demand structurally
risks.mitigation: County projected -3.7% from 2020 to 2040 (M07, T03); review DOF vintages annually.

risks.risk: Measurement/verification failure (blank or wrong source)
risks.mitigation: Every value cell carries source id and status; unverified cells are blank; script/verify.py enforces this at build time.
